title: Event Operations and Communication Management System - Code Listings for Thesis

codeSnippets.featureName: Client-Side HTML5 Canvas Image Compression and Camera Capture
codeSnippets.usedFor: Compresses on-site mobile camera photos in the browser down to ~150KB (85% JPEG quality, max 1280px resolution) before sending to MongoDB. Prevents upload timeouts on congested 4G/5G stadium networks without requiring third-party cloud storage (Cloudinary).

codeSnippets.featureName: Firebase OAuth Session Synchronization & RBAC Middleware
codeSnippets.usedFor: Synchronizes 1-tap Google Sign-In / Firebase identity with MongoDB user profiles while enforcing server-side Role-Based Access Control (EVENT_CREATOR, TEAM_LEADER, WORKER) on protected REST routes.

codeSnippets.featureName: Stateless Query-Driven Dynamic Overdue Evaluation & Operational Health Tiers
codeSnippets.usedFor: Dynamically checks task deadlines on query time (eliminating the need for a 60-second polling cron job) and assigns real-time operational health status (ON_TRACK, ATTENTION_NEEDED, CRITICAL) for Event Director decision making.

codeSnippets.featureName: Real-Time Tripartite Incident Escalation & Chat Engine
codeSnippets.usedFor: Manages isolated Socket.io rooms (issue_${issueId}) connecting the Field Worker, Team Leader, and Event Creator for instant real-time problem triage with typing indicators and persistent MongoDB message records.

codeSnippets.featureName: Task Finite State Machine (Start, Submit Proof, Approve)
codeSnippets.usedFor: Enforces the formal state transitions of tasks: NOT_STARTED -> IN_PROGRESS -> PENDING_APPROVAL (with camera proof) -> COMPLETED (upon Team Leader verification and approval).
